newsitem.title: USA: MindSpring builds NYC Internet access point.
newsitem.headline: MindSpring builds NYC Internet access point.

text.p: MindSpring Enterprises Inc said it planned to build and manage its own point of presence (PoP), or Internet access point, in New York City.
The access point, to be operational by October 1, will allow MindSpring subscribers to call the Internet through a local telephone number.
Since MindSpring started service in New York City, its customers have accessed the service through a network operated by PSINet Inc.

The new access point will feature U.S. Robotics modems, which will allow customers to access the Internet at 56 kbps, as well as 64 kbps and 128k bps Integrated Systems Digital Network (ISDN), the company said.
